title: Code review
description: Source-file code review and review-fix workflow support for completed execution work.

workflow.code_review.description: Enable code-review participation in post-execution review flows.

workflow.code_review_depth.description: Default depth for code review when no --depth override is supplied.

workflow.code_review_point.description: Loop point at which the code-review step registers — execute:post reviews once per phase (default); execute:wave:post reviews once per completed wave, scoped to that wave's diff.

code_review.window_lenses.description: Comma-separated lenses a window review (/gsd-code-review --since) runs when no --lens is supplied; each of correctness, standards, spec, simplify is its own reviewer (ADR-5208).

code_review.window_max_files_per_batch.description: Files one correctness reviewer of a window review takes; a larger window is split into batches of at most this many, one fresh reviewer each (ADR-5208). --batch-size overrides it for one run.

code_review.window_at_milestone.description: At the milestone boundary (complete-milestone, milestone:pre) the window pre-pass over the milestone's change always runs (since the last window review, else the previous v* tag); when this is on, the window review follows with one fresh reviewer per lens (/gsd-code-review --since). Off: the pre-pass summary and the command are printed and nothing more runs. One model pass per milestone, never per phase.
